items.t: The IRS Takes Up to 37% of These 5 Monthly Dividend Payers (Unless You Move Them)
items.sum: Monthly dividend checks feel like a paycheck, but in a brokerage account each one arrives with a tax bill attached. Five popular payers hide the biggest bite, and one account choice decides how much of your income you actually keep.
